title: 1、EXT. BEVERLY HILLS MANSE
summary: Rex waits in a law firm's office; the receptionist informs him that Mr. Massey will see him shortly.

title: 2、INT. MASSEY MEYERSON CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY
summary: Miles challenges Rex's expectation of discarding his wife despite his infidelity, highlighting the injustice as Rex naively seeks a favorable divorce outcome.

title: 3、EXT. RUNNING PATH - SAN VICENTE BLVD. - MORNING
summary: Ruth and Miles clash over asset demands; Rex wavers due to Ruth's past care but is persuaded by Miles to stay firm, despite Marilyn's medical distraction and emotional tensions.

title: 4、INT. GYM - CLOSE ON
summary: Patricia recalls Marylin, formerly Patty, as a child who aspired to be divorced from a rich man, a dream she sees as coming true, sharing the memory fondly despite its oddity.

title: 5、INT. SARAH SORKIN'S BEACH HOUSE - NIGHT
summary: Marylin, reflecting on family patterns and betrayal, likens her situation to a Godfather scene, vowing to see blood before her struggle ends, while Sarah offers her shelter and Ramona recalls past conflicts.

title: 6、INT. GIANT MOCK TUDOR - BEVERLY HILLS
summary: Miles and Dr. Kenneth Beck play chess, discussing past ambitions, a dual-time zone watch from a client, Botox, and unfulfilled life goals, with Kenneth noting Miles is in check.

title: 7、INT. MILES MASSEY'S OFFICE
summary: Miles questions if he's going too far; he's interrupted by a voice informing him that Herb Meyerson wants to see him, surprising Miles.

title: 8、INT. OFFICE
summary: Miles shakes hands with the ailing Herb, who wears dark glasses in the dim room, then thanks him after a labored pause.

title: 9、INT. MILES OFFICE
summary: Miles, visibly distressed, is interrupted by his intercom informing him that Marylin Rexroth has arrived and wants to see him immediately.

title: 10、INT. PRIVATE BATHROOM
summary: Marylin rebuffs Miles's disapproval of her marriage to Howard; as she leaves, Howard gropes her and mocks Miles with a high sign, deepening the tension between them.

title: 11、INT. HOWARD'S HOUSE - NIGHT
summary: Miles worries about his future and a client's marriage while playing chess, where Kenneth advises him not to waste time on the queen, metaphorically cautioning against misplaced focus in life and love.

title: 12、EXT. A WEDDING BOWER - AKA CHUPPA
summary: Marylin receives congratulations; Miles questions her about Howard's gesture, implying doubt about their future, while exchanging tense, veiled remarks about the marriage's durability and potential downfall.

title: 13、INT. LEAR JET COCKPIT
summary: A pilot and copilot hear disturbing audio on the radio, prompting the pilot to switch to a channel playing loud music and a male voice singing about Casey Jones.

title: 14、INT. CABIN OF LEAR JET
summary: Rex Rexroth, a wealthy mini-mall tycoon, is humorously depicted with two women on a toy train in a cabin, singing, while pilots discuss his potential purchase of Indiana.

title: 15、INT. MILES OFFICE
summary: Miles insists on contacting Marylin Rexroth Doyle, claiming she owes him a meal, despite Wrigley's warning; her wealth and prowess are likened to a top athlete's.

title: 16、INT. FANCY RESTAURANT
summary: Miles and Marylin drink champagne; Marylin feels betrayed, accusing Miles of thinking she orchestrated her divorce, but he comforts her, holding her hand.

title: 17、INT. CAR
summary: Miles drives Marylin to Doyle Mansion; she thanks him, silences his attempt to speak, and enters the house while he watches.

title: 18、INT. BEDROOM - MASSEY MANSION
summary: Miles receives a distressed, possibly drunk call from Marylin, who expresses self-loathing and is driving erratically on Sunset near Beverly Hills; he urgently directs her to come to his place.

title: 19、INT. DEN - MASSEY MANSION
summary: Marylin and Miles confront their emotional scars, argue about their mothers' judgments, and share a kiss after Marylin attempts to leave, signaling a shift in their relationship.

title: 20、INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT
summary: Miles proposes to Marylin, who accepts; he realizes he has no ring but offers his watch, and they share a joyful kiss, affirming their happiness.

title: 21、INT. CHAPEL
summary: Marylin insists on a marriage rooted in love and trust, embracing vulnerability despite warnings, and rejects the pre-nup to uphold shared property and emotional openness with Miles.

title: 22、INT. CHAPEL
summary: Miles and Marylin complete their wedding vows; Judge Munson pronounces them married, Wrigley cries, and a montage follows.

title: 23、INT. MASSEY HOUSE - MORNING
summary: Miles and Marylin share a tender, affectionate evening after he brings her tulips; their intimate routine includes dinner, cuddling, and bedtime closeness, reflecting deep connection and love.

title: 24、EXT. MASSEY MYERSON - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY
summary: Miles urges associates to choose love and trust over cynicism in client relationships, declaring his commitment to love, while Herb Myserson observes silently in the back.

title: 25、INT. DEN - MASSEY HOUSE
summary: Miles suggests converting a room into a nursery near the master suite, revealing his desire for children, and seeks Marylin's agreement.

title: 26、INT. QUATRAIN ANTIQUES - DAY
summary: Marylin confides in friends about her upcoming marriage to Miles, who is idealistic and happy, unlike her ex; she reflects on being a second wife and the emotional shift it brings.

title: 27、INT. FLOWER STORE - EVENING
summary: Emily confronts Miles, revealing Howard Doyle tricked him into marrying Marylin as revenge for past wrongs against her and Marylin Rexroth, with a nurse intervening.

title: 28、INT. RUTH RABINOW'S OFFICE
summary: Miles confronts Ruth about Marylin's motives, but Ruth cites attorney-client privilege, refusing to disclose information despite Miles's threats and frustration.

title: 29、INT. MASSEY HOUSE - NIGHT
summary: Miles initially rejects Marylin's redecoration and questions lost trust and dreams, but then composes himself, affirming his love and praising the design as a reflection of her.

title: 30、INT. KITCHEN
summary: Marylin enters Miles's empty bedroom, finding a note on the bed with a quote about revenge, indicating his emotional distress or intent.

title: 31、INT. KENNETH'S HOUSE
summary: Kenneth and Miles discuss the Medrano trial, doubting a conviction due to compromised evidence from the initial suicide ruling, while playing chess.

title: 32、INT. MASSEY HOUSE
summary: During a yoga class, Vishnu instructs Marylin and Sarah, who is uncomfortable with his adjustments. Marylin worries about someone absent, then hears the doorbell and leaves.

title: 33、INT. HALLWAY - MASSEY HOUSE
summary: Marylin is confronted by two police officers at her door who inform her they have a warrant for her arrest, leaving her shocked and questioning.

title: 34、INT. POLICE STATION - MONTAGE - DAY
summary: Marylin is photographed, fingerprinted, searched, stripped of jewelry, and placed in a holding tank with other women, where she clings despairingly to the bars.

title: 35、INT. POLICE STATION - DAY
summary: Ruth is admitted to the holding area.

title: 36、INT. HOLDING TANK - DAY
summary: A police officer informs Mrs. Massey she can leave because someone made bail; Marylin exits.

title: 37、INT. RUTH'S CAR
summary: Marylin is accused of fraud using someone's credit card; Ruth questions her motives and suggests cutting a deal or facing consequences, referencing Jean Harris as a cautionary example.

title: 38、INT. MASSEY HOUSE - DAY
summary: Herb angrily tells Miles to act like a man, emphasizing their role in serving and honoring the law, but asserts that obeying it is not required in their current situation.

title: 39、INT. BEDROOM - MASSEY HOUSE
summary: Miles meets gangster Joe at a clam house, representing Mr. Dumbarton to arrange the killing of Marylin Rexroth Doyle Massey within a tight timeframe; Joe agrees, noting extra payment for a painless death.

title: 40、INT. REX REXROTH MANSION
summary: Rex clutches his arm in pain, causing the dancing girls to stop and watch; one steps forward, concerned, asking what's wrong.

title: 41、INT. KENNETH'S HOUSE
summary: Miles, realizing his mistake, urgently tries to stop someone from approaching Marylin, fearing consequences after instructing them to abort plans involving her.

title: 42、INT. MASSEY MANSION - NIGHT
summary: Marylin offers Joe money to leave after mistaking him for someone sent by Mr. Dumbarton; she shows a picture of Miles, whom Joe identifies as the lawyer, as a car suddenly stops outside.

title: 43、EXT. MASSEY MANSION
summary: Massey exits the car holding a can of mace.

title: 44、INT. MANSION
summary: A gunshot rings out, a body falls; Marylin and Miles mourn, acknowledging their failed warning to Joe, who has now shot himself after the inhaler attack.

title: 45、INT. MASSEY MYERSON CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY
summary: Miles and Marylin, after a tense meeting with lawyers and mutual accusations, reach a turning point when Miles signs the pre-nup; Marylin tears it, and they share a kiss, choosing reconciliation over separation.

title: 46、EXT. MASSEY HOUSE - DAY
summary: Gardeners briefly react to a smashing sound but continue clearing leaves from the yard.

title: 47、INT. MASSEY BEDROOM
summary: Miles gives away pre-Castro Cohiba cigars to a construction worker after his pregnant wife expresses concern for his safety, reflecting on legacy and love.
